orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The IT hardware contract should be divided into two lots, each with a competitive procedure and a sustainability criterion to ensure compliance with EU thresholds and environmental standards. The first lot, IT Hardware Lot 1, will have a value of €150,000 with an energy-efficient hardware criterion (A+ or better). The second lot, IT Hardware Lot 2, will also have a value of €150,000 with a criterion for recyclable and reusable materials. The award criterion for both lots will be a best price-quality ratio with weights of 60% for price and 40% for quality. The budget shares are 5% for each lot, totaling 10% of the annual procurement budget for supplies, services, and works combined.
